description.html: The artificial plant with red flowers has narrow green leaves and several large red flowers at the tips of the stems. It stands on a blue base and brings a cheerful color into the aquarium.

An artificial plant does not wilt, needs no lighting or fertilizer and does not affect water parameters, so it is a good choice for beginners and for aquariums with fish that nibble or uproot live plants. It gives smaller fish, fry and shrimp cover and a place to rest.

The flowers are a striking detail, so place the plant somewhere clearly visible, in the middle of the aquarium. It is especially popular in children's and decorative aquariums, and you can partly cover the blue base with substrate. During regular maintenance, take the plant out and rinse it with lukewarm water, removing algae with a soft brush and no detergents. Rinse it before putting it in the aquarium for the first time as well. Browse our other decorations and equipment.
